title: Shape
description: An aircraft type's outline, measured from its manufacturer's dimensioned drawings, for drawing a scheme on it (docs/SHAPES.md). Meters: x back from the nose tip, y out from the centerline (one side; the other mirrors it), z up from the fuselage's centerline. Lines are straight between their points.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, as a relative path.

id.description: The file's name: an ICAO type designator, or one with a variant after a hyphen (e.g. 'A320', 'B738-winglets').

name.description: The type's name as people know it (Airbus A320neo).

types.description: ICAO type designators drawn with this shape.

confidence.description: How closely the outline follows the type: high from a dimensioned manufacturer drawing, lower when parts are inferred.

sources.description: The documents the shape is measured from, each with when it was read.

title.description: What it is (the manufacturer's airport-planning document, its revision).

note.description: Which drawings in it were used, and anything to know about them.

fuselage.description: The fuselage: its length and its crown, belly and half-width along it.

crown.description: Side view: [x, z] along the top, nose tip to tail cone.

belly.description: Side view: [x, z] along the bottom, nose tip to tail cone.

halfWidth.description: Plan view: [x, y] along one side, nose tip to tail cone.

widest.description: Front view: z of the cross-section's widest line (default 0).

hump.description: An upper deck standing above the main tube (a 747's): `crown` is the main tube's own top beneath it, and paint on the fuselage stays on the main tube; the hump wears the crown's paint carried up.

crown.description: Side view: [x, z] along the hump's top, from where it leaves the main crown to where it rejoins it.

width.description: Front view: the upper deck's width at its widest.

section.description: Front view: [y, z] of the fuselage's outline where the deck stands highest, from its top at the centerline down one side to where it meets the main tube's section: the deck's own cross-section.

fin.description: The fin, from the side: its leading and trailing edges from the root on the crown to the tip.

leading.description: Side view: [x, z] from the root, on the crown, to the tip.

trailing.description: Side view: [x, z] from the root, on the crown, to the tip.

fillet.description: Side view: [x, z] of a dorsal fillet's curve, from where it leaves the crown to where it meets the leading edge. Not part of the fin's space.

rudder.description: Side view: [x, z] of the rudder's hinge line, root to tip; the rudder is aft of it.

stabilizer.description: The tailplane: a surface (its plan view's edges and its height along the span), on the fuselage or on the fin.

leading.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root (at the fuselage's side, or the fin's on a T-tail) to the tip.

trailing.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root to the tip.

z.description: Front view: [y, z] of the surface's middle, root to tip.

mount.description: What it sits on: the fuselage (the default), or the fin (a T-tail: the 717, CRJ, MD-80), its root at the fin's side and its height there on the fin, high above the fuselage.

wingtip.description: A device rising from the wing's tip. Left out: a plain tip.

leading.description: Side view: [x, z] from where it leaves the wing to its tip.

trailing.description: Side view: [x, z] from where it leaves the wing to its tip.

front.description: Front view: [y, z] of its middle, from the wing to its tip.

engines.description: One side's engines, inboard first (a tail engine, on the centerline, first). Under the wing, on the rear fuselage or on the tail (`mount`); a wing may have none.

x.description: Inlet lip and exhaust (the nozzle's end, not a plug's tip).

cowlEnd.description: Where the fan cowl ends and the core or nozzle shows.

mount.description: What it hangs from: the wing (the default), the fuselage (a rear-engined type: the 717, CRJ, MD-80), on a stub pylon from the fuselage's side, or the tail (on the centerline, y 0: the MD-11's through the fin's base, the 727's in the tail cone fed by an S-duct).

duct.description: On the tail: its air path. `straight` (the default): through its nacelle, the fin standing on its top (the MD-11, DC-10); `top` and `bottom` are the nacelle's, with the fairing over its nozzle. `s`: an S-duct from an intake on the crown ahead of the fin (the 727, L-1011); `top` and `bottom` are the intake's fairing, its bottom on the crown, and `nozzle` is the engine's exhaust at the tail cone's end.

strut.description: On the tail, a straight duct: from x to x along the nacelle, where a strut joins its bottom to the crown under it.

halfWidth.description: Plan view, [x, y] along the nacelle's (or intake's) side from its own middle, inlet to exhaust: on the tail; on a wing where the nacelle isn't round (a turboprop's, deep and narrow).

propeller.description: A propeller ahead of the nacelle (a turboprop's): its disc and spinner, on the nacelle's middle out from the centerline (`y`).

x.description: Side view: the disc's plane, back from the nose.

spinner.description: Side view: from its tip to its base (where it meets the nacelle), and its diameter there.

diameter.description: The spinner's diameter at its base.

nozzle.description: On the tail: the bare exhaust where it shows, from the side (a plug's cone included).

top.description: Side view: [x, z] along its top.

bottom.description: Side view: [x, z] along its bottom.

pylon.description: On the fuselage: the stub pylon from the fuselage's side (its root) out to the nacelle (its tip), as a surface: its plan view's edges, its middle height along it from the front, and its thickness there.

y.description: The nacelle's center, out from the centerline.

top.description: Side view: [x, z] along the top, inlet to exhaust (on the tail: its outline's top, which may run on past the exhaust over a fairing).

bottom.description: Side view: [x, z] along the bottom, inlet to exhaust (on the tail: its outline's bottom; an S-duct intake's is the crown).

inlet.description: Front view: the inlet's center height and size.

cabin.description: The cabin's windows and doors, from the side.

windows.description: The main deck's window line: its height, each window's width, and where along the fuselage each is.

note.description: How the windows were placed, where the drawing doesn't show them.

wouldBe.description: A type without windows (a freighter): where its passenger version's first and last window centers are along it, meters, so paint drawn beside windows is fitted as on that version.

upperWindows.description: A second row of cabin windows above the first, on a double-deck cabin (the A380's upper deck, a 747's): as `windows`.

note.description: How the windows were placed, where the drawing doesn't show them.

doors.description: The doors, emergency exits and cargo doors, as their outlines' boxes seen from the left: on both sides unless `side` says one.

kind.description: A passenger door, an emergency exit, or a cargo door.

side.description: The one side it's on (a cargo door on the right only); left out, it's on both.

cockpit.description: The flight deck's windows, from the side.

windows.description: Side view: each pane's outline, [x, z].

gear.description: The landing gear, down, with the aircraft standing on its wheels (docs/SHAPES.md, Gear). Measured from the airport-planning document's wheelbase, track, ground clearances and tire sizes. Left out: not measured.

ground.description: The ground's height (z, below the centerline, so negative), the aircraft on its wheels at a middle weight: a part's height in the shape less its printed height above the ground (the middle of the document's range). Every tire stands on it.

legs.description: One side's legs, nose first (a leg on the centerline once; the other side mirrors the rest).

kind.description: `nose`; `main` (on the wing); `body` (a 747's, under the fuselage beside the centerline); `center` (a DC-10-30's or MD-11's, on the centerline).

x.description: The axle's distance from the nose, meters (a bogie's: its middle's, between its axles).

y.description: The leg's middle out from the centerline, meters: half the gear's track, 0 on the centerline.

mount.description: What the strut hangs from: `wing` (its lower surface over the leg, the default for main gear) or `fuselage` (the belly, the default for the others).

top.description: The strut's attachment, [x, z], where the drawing shows it (a raked strut's). Left out: straight up from the axle to the wing's lower surface or the belly.

wheels.description: Wheels on the leg: 1, 2 side by side on one axle, 4 on a two-axle bogie (two a side), 6 on a three-axle bogie.

spacing.description: Between the tires' centers across an axle, meters. Needed with more than one wheel.

tandem.description: A bogie's axles apart (first to last), meters.

tire.description: The tire's size as the document prints it, meters: [diameter, width] (a 40 x 14 in tire is [1.016, 0.356]).

checks.description: The source's printed dimensions against the shape's.

printed.description: The value printed in the source.

shape.description: The same dimension measured on the shape.

off.description: How far apart the two are.

leading.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root, at the fuselage's side, to the tip, at the nacelle.

trailing.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root to the tip.

z.description: Front view: [y, z] of its middle, root to tip.

thickness.description: Front view: its top to its bottom.

surface.description: A wing or tailplane: its plan view's edges and its height along the span.

leading.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root, at the fuselage's side, to the tip.

trailing.description: Plan view: [y, x] from the root to the tip.

z.description: Front view: [y, z] of the surface's middle, root to tip. A high wing (the Dash 8's, ATR's) has its root on the crown: z there at or above the crown.

fairings.description: A wing's flap track fairings (the canoes under its trailing edge), each as it hangs on the near side. Left out: none drawn.

y.description: Its middle's distance out from the centerline, meters.

x.description: Its front and aft ends, meters from the nose (the aft end behind the trailing edge).

depth.description: How far its lowest point hangs below the wing's lower surface, meters.

width.description: Its greatest width, meters, from the front view. Left out: as deep as it is.

flaps.description: A wing's trailing-edge flaps (docs/SHAPES.md, Flaps), as the plan view draws their lines, and the settings the document names. Left out: not measured (the flaps are drawn up).

y.description: Its inboard and outboard ends, meters out from the centerline.

chord.description: Its chord (up), as a share of the wing's chord there: from the plan view's flap line to the trailing edge.

slots.description: Its elements when down: 1 a single-slotted flap, 2 double-slotted (a vane ahead of the flap, the DC-9's), 3 triple-slotted (the 727's, 747's).

detents.description: The flap settings the document names, degrees, by what they're for (`landing`, `takeoff`; the largest is full travel). Left out: none printed, so the flaps stay up.

note.description: Where the lines and settings were read.

slats.description: A wing's leading-edge devices, as the plan view draws them, inboard first. Left out: none measured.

y.description: Its inboard and outboard ends, meters out from the centerline.

kind.description: `slat` (moves forward and down off the leading edge) or `krueger` (a panel hinged from under the leading edge, swung down and forward: the 727's and 747's inboard).

chord.description: Its chord as a share of the wing's chord there.

angle.description: How far it turns when out, degrees, where a source prints it. Left out: drawn stowed.
